mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and 33 degrees at Verona Area High School, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

City news includes a public meeting on December 8 at the Senior Center regarding the Military Ridge State Trail project, which will bring bridge replacements and new asphalt to the area. Additionally, please remember to keep your waste and recycling carts at least four feet apart and away from obstructions for easier pickup.

There is plenty to do in town with trivia tonight at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or even more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
Reviewing the weekly police report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot resulted in an arrest for O W I with a minor child in the vehicle.
Today's flavor is the delightful Caramel Turtle. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so head over to enjoy your treat.
